repositoryChecks.name: repository-tests
repositoryChecks.result: 187 tests passed; one existing Starlette httpx deprecation warning

decisions: POST /v1/query is protected by the existing bearer dependency and resolves the injected catalog repository, SAS issuer, coverage clock, range bound, and optional ensure callback through application state.
File mode is strict: mode must be file, the request has no SQL field, and only complete records whose catalog object path exactly matches the canonical partition path can receive a SAS URL.

Incomplete, missing, empty, partial, error, and malformed-path coverage is rejected with a structured 409 unless ensure=true. The injected callback is invoked with the existing EnsureRequest contract; a still-running result returns 202 with only already-complete files.
SAS issuance is delegated to the T027 SasIssuer boundary and is called only for requested complete objects. The query module does not read blobs, execute SQL, call Azure, or call a market provider.
limitations: The default application has no SAS issuer or ensure callback; deployment composition must inject those boundaries for file retrieval and optional coverage work.
The query uses the existing bounded catalog date range and equity/crypto coverage calendars. Option-specific selection remains owned by later roadmap tasks.
The complete repository Ruff, format, ty, and test checks pass after integrated verification.
Pytest emits the pre-existing FastAPI/httpx StarletteDeprecationWarning from TestClient.
No live Azure, provider, deployment, SQL engine, or network call was made.
